Results.ReviewText: The Weber Spirit E-210 gas grill is the best grill we have owned.  I spent months online and in stores checking out the pros and cons of literally dozens of grills.  The grill that the Weber replaced lasted a reasonable time and functioned alright but was not made near as well as the Weber.  We have used the Weber several times and we are very pleased with everything about the grill.  We downsized from a 4-burner with a side burner in order to step up in quality.  The Weber side tables fold down and are sturdy.  The grill area is large enough for our family get-togethers.  The thermometer is accurate.  The electronic ignition helps start the flame on the first push.  The grill heats to 600 degrees in less than 15 minutes.  The grease pan access is open and easy to get to.  The propane tank is completely hidden in a sturdy cabinet and is far enough below the grill that I no longer burn my hands turning it off.  The built in propane gas gauge is a great idea and takes the guesswork out of knowing when to swap out tanks.  The handle does not get hot at all and is easy to lift and close.  The grill is easy to move, a nice feature we did not have with our previous grill because it was so unwieldy and heavy. Everything seems to have been well thought out and engineered to last.  The steel is far superior to other grills, even those costing more.  At this price point the quality, durability, and ease of use make the Weber a top choice.

Results.ReviewText: This is an excellent grill...easy to assemble, especially if you use the mobile app as a guide.  The grill heats very quickly and does an excellent job of cooking all types of meat and vegetables.  The fold-down side shelves are a real plus for storage and should be standard on all Weber models, especially the three-burner version of the Spirit gas grill.  I opted instead for the two-burner grill because of the fold-down shelves.  This grill is well-built of sturdy materials and the caster style wheels make it easy to move about.  The only flaw I can point to is a design flaw involving the positioning of the LP gas bottle inside the enclosed compartment beneath the grill.  Installing the bottle onto the hook for the weight-based gauge is extremely difficult due to the weight of the full bottle (40 lbs) and the very tight space inside the cabinet.  There is almost no room to obtain leverage to lift the heavy bottle onto the hook.  This is a three-handed operation and there is no helpful guide in the owner's manual for dealing with this difficult installation.  I managed it in the end by placing a thin piece of plywood over the hole in the compartment floor as I maneuvered the bottle into place on the hook and then sliding the plywood piece out from under the bottle so that it would hang properly on the hook.  Not an easy installation!  Weber engineers, you need to fix this flaw!  Apart from that, I fully endorse this grill and expect to get years of good use out of it.

Results.ReviewText:
First off, I grill meats only - no veggie experience.  Ribs, chicken and steak.  For ribs and chicken, I use a grill mat cut just a bit smaller than the grill surface - works great with this grill.  Really minimized flareups!  Steaks go right on grill; I usually do sirloins with lower fat content. This grill holds temperature really well.  On my covered patio I can grill even on cooler days (45F min).  For four or less people, this grill holds plenty of food.  Grill would probably bog down big-time if you overload the cooking surface. It does not have an upper warming/holding rack.  Only two burners, but they are adequate for the grill surface, and probably more economical on LP than three burners (if all on).
I've had this grill for 3-4 years, and only thing I've replaced (just recently) is the enamel flavorizer bars.  Got a set on Amazon for $20, fit perfectly.  Got a spare tank at Costco, so always have gas on hand.  Grill itself cleans easily with the removable drip tray.  Burners and grill box itself require minimal cleaning/upkeep.  I do keep the grill covered when not in use - rust and flareups are a grill's biggest enemies.  One big plus is the fold-down side trays; these really minimize the footprint for patio storage.  Summary - best grill I've owned.

Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.
